rules: Vertical DONE is necessary but not sufficient for VERIFIED_CLOSED.
VERIFIED_CLOSED requires every applicable dimension VERIFIED; N_A is allowed only with a rationale; independent acceptance must be VERIFIED.
PARTIAL, MISSING, or BLOCKED in any applicable dimension forbids VERIFIED_CLOSED.
Dependencies must reference known stories and the dependency graph must be acyclic.
External, field, and upstream gates cannot be self-closed by repository mocks or same-owner evidence.
Latest-solution assessment may KEEP a stable implementation; novelty is not a closure requirement.

release_provenance.note: Use GitHub Artifact Attestations/Sigstore and SLSA provenance semantics rather than a private signing format.

durable_execution.note: Temporal confirms durable event history plus idempotent external operations as mature practice; keep SpatialRuntime's narrower evidence/reconciliation boundary rather than reimplementing a general workflow engine.

observability.note: Use OpenTelemetry for telemetry naming/correlation; do not promote telemetry success into authoritative external-effect truth.
